title: 第7章 威压慑神山帝族的恐怖第8章 江家的聘礼之一准帝兵
slug: 多子多福家族帮我攻略极品仙子
lines: 大殿内死寂一片。
所有人都没想到，江战会说出这样的话。
不是来提亲凤凰神女的?
那太古神山论尊卑有谁能配得上江渊？
毕竟即便江渊无法修炼，他也是大帝亲子，论地位只有三大皇族神女才能勉强配得上。
凤灵儿的脸色瞬间僵住了，她那高傲的神情在这一刻变得有些滑稽。
凤凰老祖也愣住了，随即脸色变得古怪起来。
黄金狮族族长和神族族长对视一眼，都从对方眼中看到了错愕。
“江家主，你这话是什么意思?”
江战负手而立，扫视全场:“本座此次前来太古神山，是为渊儿向白虎王族的白虎神女，白清雪提亲。”
轰!
这话一出，整个大殿炸了。
“白虎王族?那个没落的王族?”
“白清雪?我记得她，太古白虎血脉，资质倒是不错，但白虎王族现在连个圣境强者都没有了吧?”
“江家居然看上了白虎王族?”
十大王族的族长们窃窃私语，脸上都带着不可思议的表情。
白虎王族，曾经也是太古神山的大族之一，仅次于十大王族之下的第一梯队，
但在数万年前的一场大战中，族中强者几乎死绝，如今只剩下几百族人，
连圣境强者都没有，在太古神山的地位早已一落千丈。
要不是白虎一族的血脉还算纯正，恐怕早就被踢出十大王族的行列了。
而白清雪，虽然觉醒太古白虎血脉，靠着白虎王族得了个神女的尊位，但在整个太古神山，也只能算是中上之选。
和凤凰神女凤灵儿这种万年难遇的天才相比，差了不止一个档次。
凤灵儿整个人都傻了。
她刚才那番话说得义正言辞，结果人家根本不是来找她的?
那她刚才那番表态算什么?
自作多情?
她的脸色一阵青一阵白，胸口剧烈起伏，显然气得不轻。
凤凰老祖的脸色更是难看到了极点。
他本以为江家是来提亲凤灵儿的，所以才召集了三大皇族和十大王族的人，
不管成或不成都能体现出他凤凰一族的强势，
结果江家根本不是来找他们的!
这不是打他的脸吗!
“江家主，你确定没说错?”凤凰老祖声音有些沙哑，“白虎王族那种没落的小族，也配得上你们江家?”
“配不配得上，不是你说了算，是我江家说了算，再说，凤老前辈方才不是说了吗，高攀江家了。”
凤凰老祖噎住了。
这话确实是他说的，但那是客套话啊!
谁能想到江家来真的!
“而且，”江战平静道，“我江家帝子何等尊贵，岂是什么人都能配得上的?方才那位神女说得对，她确实配不上我家渊儿。”
凤灵儿脸色煞白，身体微微颤抖。
她从小到大，何曾受过这种羞辱?
“你……你敢辱我！”
“辱你？”
一直没说话的三长老江守拙，此刻终于忍不住了，他往前踏出一步，一股恐怖的准帝威压瞬间笼罩向凤灵儿。
江守拙的脾气本来就火爆，从进这太古神山开始，就憋了一肚子的火。
content_en:
There was dead silence in the hall.
No one expected Jiang Zhan to say such words.
Aren’t you here to propose marriage to the Phoenix Goddess?
In terms of superiority and inferiority in the ancient sacred mountain, who can be worthy of Jiang Yuan?
After all, even if Jiang Yuan is unable to practice, he is still the son of the emperor, and in terms of status, only the three royal goddesses can barely match him.
Feng Ling'er's face froze instantly, and her arrogant expression became a little funny at this moment.
The Phoenix Ancestor was also stunned, and then his expression became strange.
The leader of the Golden Lion Clan and the leader of the God Clan looked at each other, and they both saw surprise in each other's eyes.
"Master Jiang, what do you mean by this?"
Jiang Zhan stood with his hands behind his hands and scanned the audience: "I came to the Ancient Sacred Mountain this time to propose marriage to Bai Qingxue, the White Tiger Goddess of the White Tiger Royal Family, for Yuan'er."
Boom!
As soon as these words came out, the entire hall exploded.
"The White Tiger Royal Family? That declining royal family?"
"Bai Qingxue? I remember her. She is of the ancient White Tiger bloodline and has good qualifications, but the White Tiger royal family doesn't even have a strong person in the Holy Realm now, right?"
"The Jiang family actually has a crush on the White Tiger Royal Family?"
The heads of the ten royal families whispered, with incredible expressions on their faces.
The White Tiger Royal Clan was once one of the great clans in the Taikoo Sacred Mountain, second only to the first echelon of the ten major royal clans.
But in a great war tens of thousands of years ago, the strongest members of the clan were almost wiped out, and now only a few hundred clan members are left.
There are not even powerful men in the Holy Realm, and their status in the Ancient Sacred Mountain has already plummeted.
If the bloodline of the White Tiger clan had not been relatively pure, they would have been kicked out of the top ten royal clans long ago.
As for Bai Qingxue, although she awakened the bloodline of the ancient white tiger and obtained the title of goddess through the white tiger royal family, she could only be regarded as the middle-to-upper choice in the entire ancient sacred mountain.
Compared with a rare genius like Phoenix Goddess Feng Ling'er, she was more than one level behind.
Feng Ling'er was completely stunned.
What she just said was righteous, but in the end, they didn't come to see her at all?
So what does her statement just now mean?
Self-indulgent?
Her face turned blue and white, her chest heaved violently, and she was obviously very angry.
The Phoenix Patriarch's expression was even more ugly.
He originally thought that the Jiang family was here to propose to Feng Ling'er, so he summoned people from the three major royal families and the ten major royal families.
Whether he succeeds or fails, it will reflect the strength of his Phoenix clan.
It turns out that the Jiang family didn’t come to find them at all!
Isn't this a slap in the face?
"Master Jiang, are you sure you are right?" Phoenix Patriarch's voice was a little hoarse, "How can a declining clan like the White Tiger Royal Family be worthy of your Jiang Family?"
"Whether you deserve it or not, it's not you who has the final say, it's my Jiang family who has the final say. Besides, didn't Senior Feng just say that he has the upper hand over the Jiang family?"
Ancestor Phoenix choked.
These words were indeed said by him, but they were polite words!
Who would have thought that the Jiang family would come true!
"Furthermore," Jiang Zhan said calmly, "I am so noble as the emperor of the Jiang family, how can anyone be worthy of me? The goddess just now was right, she is indeed not worthy of my Yuan'er."
Feng Ling'er's face turned pale and her body trembled slightly.
Ever since she was a child, had she ever been humiliated like this?
"You...you dare to insult me!"
"Insulting you?"
The third elder, Jiang Shouzhuo, who had been silent all this time, finally couldn't bear it anymore. He took a step forward, and a terrifying quasi-emperor pressure instantly enveloped Feng Ling'er.
Jiang Shouzhuo had a fiery temper, and he had been holding back his anger ever since he entered the ancient sacred mountain.
